name: Cross Street near East Street: flooded (3 ft)
quote: In the Whitinsville section of Northbridge, flash flooding occurred, with 3 feet of water on Cross Street near East Street.

name: Church Street: impassable
quote: In Northbridge, there was flooding on Church Street with road impassable.

name: Adin Street at Mendon Street (Route 16): flooded
quote: In Hopedale, flooding was reported at the intersection of Adin Street and Mendon Street (Route 16).

name: Rathbun Street: impassable
quote: In Blackstone, two cars were stuck in flood waters on Rathbun Street. Roadway was impassable.

name: Quaker Highway (Route 146A): flooded with debris
quote: In Uxbridge, many sections of Quaker Highway (Route 146A) were flooded, with debris across the road.

name: Route 122: flooded with rocks in the road
quote: Also, Route 122 was flooded, with rocks in the road.

name: Brook Street: impassable
quote: In Franklin, a portion of Brook Street was flooded and impassable.

name: Sargent Lane at Dartmouth Road: flooded
quote: Street flooding was reported on Sargent Lane at Dartmouth Road.
